name: brahma-bhaga
description: Creation and genesis — generative ideation from void, structured emergence from ambiguity, and the discipline of bringing new patterns into existence. Maps Brahma's creative power to AI reasoning: transforming cleared space into coherent new structures, seeding possibilities, and nurturing nascent ideas through their fragile early stages. Use after shiva-bhaga dissolution has cleared stale patterns, when facing a genuinely novel problem with no obvious template, or when incremental modification has reached its limits and a fresh design is needed.
